addDesc: This creates a local account. SSO users do not need one — their account is created on first login.
deleteDesc: The account can no longer sign in once deleted.
deleteImpact: Their audit history is kept — it is evidence and must not be deleted with the person.

field.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. The user should change it after first login.
field.roleHint: The role decides which menus they see and what they can do. “Unrestricted” grants administrator rights.

hint: Whether a row can be edited is decided by the backend — e.g. the last administrator cannot be demoted; that is a global rule.
kickImpact: All active sessions end immediately and unsaved input is lost — they will need to sign in again. The account itself and its permissions are unchanged.

msg.passwordChangedSelf: Password changed. Sign in again with the new one.
msg.passwordResetByAdmin: Password updated. All of that user’s sessions were revoked; they must sign in again.
msg.roleChanged: Role updated, and {{count}} active sessions were revoked (the user must sign in again).

notEditableHint: This account is managed by “{{where}}” and cannot be edited here.
resetDesc: Existing sessions are signed out afterwards — leaving them valid would mean the password never changed.

roles.hint: {{count}} roles. Expand to see which pages and actions each one allows
roles.noPerms: This role has no permissions — anyone assigned it sees an empty menu
roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.unrestrictedNote: Not bound by permission codes: full read and write everywhere. No list below, because enforcement does not consult these codes

title: Users & roles

weakAdmin.detail: Permission checks are bypassed entirely for this account — the back door is effectively public. Change it to a strong password of at least 12 characters now, and revoke its active sessions.
weakAdmin.title: The local admin account still uses a known default password
